# Contributor Code of Conduct

[简体中文](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) | **English**

## Our pledge

We are committed to a friendly, respectful, harassment-free collaboration
environment for every participant, regardless of experience, identity,
background, or viewpoint.

## Expected behavior

- Discuss problems and evidence without attacking people.
- Accept reasonable technical feedback and explain the basis for decisions.
- Respect maintainer and contributor time by providing reproduction and context.
- Stop spreading inappropriate content and refer it to the maintainer.

## Unacceptable behavior

Insults, harassment, threats, disclosure of private information, sustained
disruption, or any behavior that makes participants unsafe is unacceptable.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may remove inappropriate content, restrict participation, or ban
serious offenders permanently.

To report behavior involving the maintainer or unsuitable for public discussion,
use a currently published private contact method from
[@realSilasYang](https://github.com/realSilasYang). If private contact is not
available, open an issue without sensitive details asking to move the discussion
privately. Reports are shared only as necessary. Enforcement may include a
warning, content removal, temporary restriction, or permanent exclusion based on
impact, history, and context.

This simplified policy is based on Contributor Covenant 2.1 and adapted to the
size of this project.
